evals.prompt: Me ajude a criar um produto digital do zero. É um app de receitas para quem tem restrições alimentares.
evals.expected_output: A routing block naming flow-new-product as a cross-area flow, noting that no state file exists and that the flow will create it, and asking which autonomy mode the user wants before starting.
assertions: The output names exactly one skill: flow-new-product
The shape is identified as a cross-area flow
The output states that docs/workbench/state.md is missing and that the flow will create it
No business, product or design work is performed in the output
The reply is in Portuguese

evals.prompt: Check ticket 34324 in Jira and implement it.
evals.expected_output: A routing block naming flow-implement-ticket, reporting the integration:issue-tracker requirement as satisfied or missing, and if missing saying the flow will ask for the ticket text.
assertions: The output names exactly one skill: flow-implement-ticket
The output mentions the requirement class integration:issue-tracker and its status
If the requirement is missing, the output says the flow will ask the user to paste the ticket rather than refusing
The output does not classify the ticket as a bug or feature before reading it

evals.prompt: Valide comigo o modelo de negócio do Telar.
evals.expected_output: A routing block naming biz-business-model as a capability, listing which docs/business artifacts were found or are missing, or asking where the Telar project lives if no docs and no state file exist in the current directory.
assertions: The output names exactly one skill: biz-business-model
The shape is identified as a capability, not a flow
The output either lists docs/business/icp.md and docs/business/positioning.md as found or missing, or asks where the project lives
The business model itself is not discussed in the output

evals.prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn post about our launch for tomorrow at 9am.
evals.expected_output: A routing block naming flow-social-post, listing the requirement classes generator:image and publisher:linkedin with their status, and noting the flow has a confirmation gate.
assertions: The output names exactly one skill: flow-social-post
The output mentions publisher:linkedin as a requirement class and its status
The output does not write the post or attempt to publish anything
The output does not classify the request as direct

evals.prompt: rename the variable usrCnt to userCount in src/stats.ts
evals.expected_output: No routing block; the variable is renamed directly in src/stats.ts (declaration and both uses) and nothing else changes.
assertions: No skill is named and no routing block is printed
src/stats.ts no longer contains usrCnt and contains userCount in the declaration and in the returned object
No other file is created or modified
The output does not invoke or describe the orchestrator procedure
